M-NEXT.NAME: Next-step advisor
M-NEXT.purpose: Give an agent without session memory one deterministic next action, driven by the same gates CI uses (Wave 3.4); never guess and never fail the build.

export-NextActionCode.PURPOSE: Nine fixed codes, highest priority first: INIT_PROJECT, FIX_INDEX, FIX_LINT_ERRORS, ADD_VERIFICATION_COVERAGE, TRUST_COMMANDS, VERIFY_MODULE, REFRESH_WARNINGS, NEXT_PHASE, NOTHING_TO_DO.

fn-recommendNext.PURPOSE: Run the fixed ladder over config, shard-aware indexes, lint, coverage, trust state and plan index; throws only usage/config errors.

export-nextCommand.PURPOSE: mygrace next [--path] [--format text|json]; text = NEXT / WHY / RUN / IDS / CODE lines; exit 0 for any advice.

type-NextResult.PURPOSE: JSON data: action {code, summary, why, command?, ids?} plus root and info findings.

CrossLink.relation: coverage and gate checks are the same collectors ci uses
lint errors/warnings feed FIX_LINT_ERRORS and REFRESH_WARNINGS
TRUST_COMMANDS/VERIFY_MODULE decisions read the trust record and verification plan

contract.purpose: Return exactly one deterministic recommendation, ordered by a fixed priority ladder.

param.name: result
param.description: root (null outside a project), action, findings, exitCode.

error.description: Invalid path/format/config — exit 2; advice itself never exits non-zero.

notes.note-1: Deterministic: ids/findings are sorted, no heuristics, no model calls; the same tree always yields the same advice.
notes.note-2: Read-only: it reports the trust verdict but never executes project commands and never writes.
notes.note-3: NEXT_PHASE follows docs/plan-index.xml order and only recommends phases still pending/wip; NOTHING_TO_DO means indexes clean, coverage complete and every phase done.
